title: Cloudflare to cut about 20% workforce
summary: Cloudflare, a major internet infrastructure and cloud services company, announced plans to reduce its workforce by approximately 20%, affecting over 1,100 employees. The company stated this is part of a strategic restructuring to 'build for the future,' suggesting a shift in business focus or efficiency optimization amid changing market conditions.
problem_solved: This news does not describe a technical solution; it reports on corporate restructuring and layoffs in the technology sector.
why_valuable: This represents a significant development in the tech industry's ongoing workforce adjustments and provides insight into Cloudflare's strategic direction.
